  > 
  > 1. **Table 2, column "R² abs."** The caption says it is the absolute held-out R² of log|bias|, but the combined-score rows (1), (1′) and the S_adj combined row (0.32, 0.34, 0.43) are R² of log RMSE (`diagnostic_absolute.csv`), while the (3ii), (3ii′) and S_adj bias rows (−0.12, −0.22, −0.06) are of log|bias| (`bias_reference.csv`). Please name the target per row or split the column (your layout choice; the caption in `appendix.tex` is mine and I will follow what you deliver). Also, `bias_reference.csv` now has the held-out constant row on the 1224 cells (−0.239): please add it to the "Reference predictors of log|bias|" block of Table 2 (the text now says S̄ and p(1−p) do no better than a constant).
  > 2. **Paper numbers in REPRODUCE.md section 9 and CAPTIONS.md.** The paper numbers the figures: Fig. 1 `fig3_bias_sd`, Fig. 2 `fig1_regime_map`, Fig. 3 `fig5_tiers`, Fig. 4 `fig9_coverage`, Fig. 5 `fig7_diagnostic`, Fig. 6 `figA2_variance`, Fig. 7 `figA4_p`, Fig. 8 `figA8_robust`, **Fig. 9 `figA9_orfit` (fitted-form oracle), Fig. 10 `fig6_cluster` (cluster designs)**. REPRODUCE.md currently maps Fig. 9 to `fig6_cluster` and "Fig. A9" to `figA9_orfit`. Tables: 1 `t3_regime`, 2 `t2_acceptance`, 3 and 4 `t1_mechanisms` / `t1_calibration_full`. CAPTIONS.md still lacks the paper number for each item: please add it. (Checked against the system build of dev e79190a.)
